title: Design: No-charge line menu offers Change category and Mark as Billable
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with two lines: each with 1.0 h of labor and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Mark the second line No Charge with the category Warranty.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow6-04-04-line-menu-change-category-mark-as-billable-v14.png, iwo-happy-33-33-line-menu-change-category-mark-as-billable-v14.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the billable work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu of the no-charge line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu holds "Change category" and "Mark as Billable", each with an icon like the other items.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R5: “The three-dots menu of a no-charge line offers "Change category" (the dialog of S12-R2 with the current values; Save is enabled once the category, the original work order or the original line differs) and "Mark as Billable" (confirmation "Mark line as billable?" with the body "The line is priced as a new line would be today. You can mark it No Charge again until the work order is invoiced."); confirming removes the chip and the category and prices the line as S2-R6 prices a line: labor at the customer's rate, else the location's; parts from the pricing rules on the cost already on the line. Both are unavailable once the work order is invoiced; the invoice is reversed first, as for Convert (S2-R9).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794565397-7f4c (read and rendered 14 Nov 2026: from version 1794561577-f903 one string changed, the chip of a no-charge line now reads "No Charge" on 6 boards; the other 161 boards are pixel-identical): pages "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order" / "Happy flow v6", boards "04 Line menu · Change category, Mark as Billable" (Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order), "33 Line menu · Change category, Mark as Billable" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow6-04-04-line-menu-change-category-mark-as-billable-v14.png
  • iwo-happy-33-33-line-menu-change-category-mark-as-billable-v14.png

The design's own words:

  • “Mark as Billable”

Difference: icons missing on the design (IWO-D38); the Mark line as billable confirmation is not drawn (IWO-D40), settled by S12-R5.
